clothFit.method: highest actual support under measured proximal-patch witnesses

frameTiming.scope: Consecutive moving frames, including intervals >=500ms; reset after visibility/pause changes.

atmosphere.method: Hillaire 2020 transmittance, multiple-scattering and sky-view tables on Bruneton's parameterization

farField.method: the modelled land drawn from above, and the hinterland's regional surface continued to 32 km, ray-marched inside the dome

stars.method: Yale Bright Star Catalogue (public domain) precessed to the date and turned by sidereal time; Schaefer 1993 naked-eye limit for the sky's brightness

optics.method: Lee et al. 1998 shallow-water reflectance over a captured seabed / paraxial ripple caustics / Pope and Fry pure-water absorption

haze.method: exponential height haze from scene depth, horizon-lit; the modelled land and sea dissolve into the dome's far field before the far plane and the sea plane's edge

volume.method: shadow-mapped single-scattering march (haze shafts, marine fog, indoor dust), joint-bilateral upsampled

rain.method: active-time seeded exterior line field in a world-stable camera box, clipped to terrain and covered volumes

roofClip.method: conservative swept XZ footprint over actual static roof triangles

coupling.method: Gaussian submerged palm / exponential face drag

caustics.method: paraxial lens of the simulated surface: 1/|det(I + l(1-1/n) Hess h)|, central differences over one cell

stroke.method: prescribed anatomical IK / measured submerged palm velocity

optics.method: Three r164 screen-space refracted background / Beer-Lambert attenuation

wind.method: coast breeze and gust fronts, indoor share through the glass front / six-mode curl eddies / critically damped rooted bends
wind.contactNormalApproximation: static leaves in the contact pass; bends saturate softly toward 15 mm

coast.method: sea-breeze cycle (periodic Hermite over velocity knots) / hashed gust fronts on retarded time / six indoor eddy modes

cloth.method: XPBD small steps (cloth-solver.mjs): stretch/shear distance constraints, isometric bending, long-range attachments to the ring clips, fold ordering, contacts with friction, per-triangle flat-plate air force

draft.method: coast indoor air + soft-clamped jets of the coast's onshore breeze with advected curl eddies + glass boundary layer

interiorReflections.method: cropped planar room and live actor reflections

limits: Static opaque geometry and one Lambertian bounce; no dynamic actor/leaf/coast displacement visibility
First-order directional irradiance; sparse moment visibility is approximate and may leak across unsampled thin walls
Material base color/metalness only; texture, vertex color and procedural detail are not baked
Actual sky gradient plus authored far-ground boundary; solar disk/cloud/stars and direct-sun bounce omitted
Final authored emitter-radius segment is unoccluded to model a diffuse bulb within its shade
Bathroom cove bounce uses an equal-energy midpoint approximation; direct lighting integrates the full segments
Transparent, refracted, volumetric and specular transport remain native approximations; no ray-traced caustics
Native direct practical lights remain unshadowed; only cached indirect bounce includes traced visibility
Outside the bounded regions uses unoccluded actual-sky diffuse fallback

steam.method: Beer–Lambert emission-free single scattering / nearest transmission-interface split

scalar.method: prescribed curl wind / temperature rise / RK2 semi-Lagrangian scalars / positive diffusion

transport.scope: Actual new field, no saved cache; final source inputs and cache publication belong to the coordinator
